corrections.name: Lovely Showtime
corrections.effect: Ribrianne performs up to seven poses; completing the sequence produces a powerful reinforcement effect that raises Ki and Stamina capacity.
corrections.reason: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation explicitly identifies Attack Type as Power Up, Skill Type as Ultimate, and Ki Used as 200. The canonical class/subcategory are therefore Ultimate / Power Up; this correction only reconciles the effect wording with the documented mechanics.

notes: Lovely Showtime is unavailable to CaCs. The repository taxonomy uses Power Up as the subcategory rather than Other.
